core_obligations: Display the decomposition of syntomicity into local finite presentation, flatness and locally complete intersection fibres (proof lines 6376-6377).
Recall that flatness and local finite presentation are already fpqc local on the base (proof lines 6378-6381).
Apply the locality of the local complete intersection condition on fibres to conclude (proof lines 6382-6383).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that syntomicity is fpqc local on the base (statement lines 6369-6373). The proof displays the decomposition it uses -- a morphism is syntomic if and only if it is locally of finite presentation, flat, and has locally complete intersection fibres -- recalls that flatness and local finite presentation are already known to be fpqc local on the base, and concludes with the lemma stating that the locus where the fibres are local complete intersections is fpqc local on the base (proof lines 6375-6383). The level is H2: the three ingredients of the decomposition are named and matched to their inputs rather than merely asserted.
